season.title: Season One: THE BLACK LEDGER
season.disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. Zimbabwe is used as recognisable geography. Every named character, unit, agency and organisation is invented. Nothing here depicts or accuses any real person or institution.

characters.name: Tinashe Mukasa
characters.bio: Former elite Directorate operative. Led Operation Silent Gate. Blamed for the failure, cleared by no one, forced out. Quiet, analytical, emotionally guarded. Drives trucks and remembers everything.

characters.name: Amara Chikowore
characters.bio: Tinashe's former intelligence contact. Brilliant at surveillance, encrypted communications and digital investigation. She stayed in the service. She is hiding what she saw the night Silent Gate failed.

characters.name: General Daniel Muponda
characters.bio: Former intelligence director. Knows the origins of the Shadow Protocol. Condemns Silent Gate publicly and privately insists it saved the country. Never explains it properly.

characters.name: Victor Nhari
characters.bio: Meridian Strategic Group field operative. Tasked with recovering the Black Ledger. Knows Tinashe personally. Anticipates every move he makes. Officially dead three years ago.

characters.name: Tafadzwa Dube
characters.bio: Investigative reporter for The Ledger. Connecting missing persons, suspicious financial transactions and the Shadow Network. Will publish everything, including this.

characters.name: Deputy Director Emmanuel Mhara
characters.bio: The officer who disappeared the same night the Black Ledger was stolen. Sent the warning to Tinashe. Presumed missing by everyone who still answers the Directorate phone.

characters.name: Adrian Voss
characters.bio: International businessman with connections to private security, intelligence contractors and financial interests. Nobody knows whether he created the Shadow Protocol or bought it.

characters.name: Lovemore Chigumba
characters.bio: Mbare bus-terminus porter. Saw who emptied the locker. Scared, quiet, otherwise uninvolved. The kind of man the Shadow Network calls collateral.

factions.name: Meridian Strategic Group
factions.description: The Shadow Protocol's tactical arm. Executes recovery of the Black Ledger and suppression of witnesses. Never publicly bids on anything.

factions.name: The Shadow Network
factions.description: Umbrella of security firms, brokers, ministries, media buyers and discreet diplomats. No HQ, no leadership, no minutes. The protocol is its product.

factions.name: The Directorate
factions.description: Tinashe's former employer. Stability above truth. Hunting the leak while pretending the leak does not know it is being hunted.

factions.name: The Ledger
factions.description: Tafadzwa Dube's paper. Connected missing persons to shell accounts. One leak away from being bought, sued or burned.
